options.name: __DEBUG_MODE
options.description: This will print debug logs to console about unusual scenarios. Recommended to enable if you wish to help us improve our products and find bugs / issues with it!

options.name: ReadMe
options.description: Includes an embedded help document with export notes and limitations.

options.name: Binary
options.description: Saves as a binary file (.rbxl/.rbxm) instead of XML (.rbxlx/.rbxmx). Much smaller and faster to load. Pass `XML = true` for the opposite.

options.name: CompressionMode
options.description: How chunks are compressed in binary mode: "zstd", "lz4", or false for none.

options.name: CompressionLevel
options.description: Compression strength, higher is smaller but slower. Range is -7 to 22 inclusive.

options.name: CopyToClipboard
options.description: Puts the finished output on the clipboard instead of writing a file, so you can paste it straight into Studio. Best for small saves -- a full place is usually far too big for the clipboard to handle.

options.name: RiskyServicesDisabled
options.description: Per-service kill switches for services games might detect. `UGC` skips UGCValidationService (GHP fallback reads, `MeshPart.VertexCount`). `Encoding` skips EncodingService (base64 encode/decode, zstd compression falls back to other funcs). `Reflection` skips ReflectionService (one of several API dump fallbacks, `Content` property lookups -- falls back to the other API dump sources). Examples: `{UGC = true}` disables only UGCValidationService; `{Encoding = true, Reflection = true}` disables both, leaving UGC untouched.

options.name: SafeMode
options.description: Deliberately disconnects the client before saving and may enable script termination and rendering changes. It does not guarantee protection.

options.name: KillAllScripts
options.description: Attempts to terminate other client scripts. SafeMode can enable this implicitly; it can prevent movement and disrupt the client.

options.name: BoostFPS
options.description: Massively boosts FPS by disabling 3D rendering. Other options also enable it, like: SafeMode.

options.name: ShutdownWhenDone
options.description: Shuts the game down after saveinstance is finished.

options.name: AntiIdle
options.description: Prevents the 20-minute-Idle Kick.

options.name: Anonymous
options.description: * **RISKY:** Removes your Name and UserId from the file -- useful for games that store them in GUIs or other Instances. Can also be a table with UserId and/or Name keys to pick the replacements. May mess up unrelated text or numbers that happen to match. Inside attributes and tags the replacement is padded to the same length, so a name shorter than yours comes out as for example `Roblox____`.

options.name: ShowStatus
options.description: Displays the export progress interface while the engine runs.

options.name: WorkBudgetMs
options.description: Cooperative Lua work budget in milliseconds, clamped to 1–16. Smaller budgets give the game more scheduler time but can lengthen exports. Native calls cannot be preempted.

options.name: Callback
options.description: If set, the serialized data will be sent to the callback function instead of to file.

options.name: mode
options.description: Valid modes: full, optimized, scripts. Change this to invalid mode like "invalid" if you only want ExtraInstances. "optimized" mode is **NOT** supported with *@Object* option.

options.name: Decompile
options.description: Script decompiling.

options.name: scriptcache
options.description: Use decompiled script cache to avoid decompiling duplicate scripts.

options.name: DecompileTimeout
options.description: If the decompilation run time exceeds this value it gets cancelled. Set to -1 to disable timeout.

options.name: BytecodeTimeout
options.description: If the SaveBytecode run time exceeds this value it gets cancelled. Set to -1 to disable timeout.

options.name: DecompileJobless
options.description: Includes already decompiled code in the output. No new scripts are decompiled.

options.name: SaveBytecode
options.description: Includes bytecode in the output. Useful if you wish to be able to decompile it yourself later. Respects **@DecompileIgnore**.

options.name: DecompileIgnore
options.description: Ignores matched instances and their descendants by default. To ignore only the instance itself, set the value to `false`. Examples: `"Chat"` matches any instance with ClassName "Chat"; `Players = {"MyPlayerName"}` matches class "Players" AND name "MyPlayerName" only; `workspace` matches a specific instance by reference; `[workspace] = false` matches a specific instance by reference, ignoring only itself and not its descendants.

options.name: IgnoreList
options.description: Structure mirrors **@DecompileIgnore**, except `false` means keep the instance but ignore its descendants. Supports both instance references and ClassName strings. Examples: `"CoreGui"` skips entirely; `CorePackages = false` keeps the instance but skips its descendants; `Players = {"SomePlayer"}` skips a specific named instance with specific ClassName.

options.name: ExcludeModuleScripts
options.description: Exports ModuleScript containers as Folders, preserving their names and descendants without reading their Source or bytecode. Explicit IgnoreList rules still take priority.

options.name: ExtraInstances
options.description: If used with any invalid mode (like "invalidmode") it will only save these instances.

options.name: IgnoreProperties
options.description: Ignores properties by Name.

options.name: SaveCacheInterval
options.description: The less the value the more often it saves, but that would mean less performance due to constantly saving. XML Only.

options.name: FilePath
options.description: The name (can include a path) of the file to save to. If it has no extension, `.rbxmx/rbxm` (models) or `.rbxlx/rbxl` (places) is appended; an existing extension is left as-is. Ignores `OPTIONS.AvoidFileOverwrite`.

options.name: AvoidFileOverwrite
options.description: Prevents writing to place file that already exists.

options.name: Object
options.description: * If provided, saves as .rbxmx (Model file) instead. If Object is game, it will be saved as a .rbxl file. **MUST BE AN INSTANCE REFERENCE, FOR EXAMPLE - *game.Workspace***. `"optimized"` mode is **NOT** supported with this option. If IsModel is set to false then Object specified here will be saved as a place file.

options.name: IsModel
options.description: If Object is specified then sets to true automatically, unless you set it to false.

options.name: NilInstances
options.description: Save instances that aren't Parented (Parented to nil).

options.name: NilInstancesFixes
options.description: * This can cause some Classes to be fixed even though they might not need the fix (better be safe than sorry though). For example, Bones inherit from Attachment if we dont define them in the NilInstancesFixes then this will catch them anyways. **TO AVOID THIS BEHAVIOR USE THIS EXAMPLE:** {ClassName_That_Doesnt_Need_Fix = false}.
options.default: {Animator = function, AdPortal = function, BaseWrap = function, Attachment = function}

options.name: IgnoreDefaultProperties
options.description: Ignores default properties during saving. XML Only (XML=true) because Binary (default) doesn't really need it.

options.name: IgnoreNotArchivable
options.description: Ignores the Archivable property and saves Non-Archivable instances.

options.name: IgnorePropertiesOfNotScriptsOnScriptsMode
options.description: Ignores property of every instance that is not a script in "scripts" mode.

options.name: IgnoreSpecialProperties
options.description: Prevents calls to `gethiddenproperty` and uses fallback methods instead. This also helps with crashes. If your file is corrupted after saving, you can try turning this on.

options.name: IsolateStarterPlayer
options.description: Saves StarterPlayer as separate folder, children of the original instance will be ignored.

options.name: IsolatePlayers
options.description: Saves All Players as separate folder, children of the original instance will be ignored.

options.name: IsolateLocalPlayer
options.description: Saves LocalPlayer as separate folder, original instance will be ignored.

options.name: IsolateLocalPlayerCharacter
options.description: Saves LocalPlayer.Character as separate folder, original instance will be ignored.

options.name: SavePlayerCharacters
options.description: Save player characters while saving.

options.name: SaveNotCreatable
options.description: * Includes non-serializable instances as Folder objects (Name is misleading as this is mostly a fix for certain NilInstances and isn't always related to NotCreatable). Other options also enable it, like: IsolatePlayers, IsolateLocalPlayer, etc.

options.name: NotCreatableFixes
options.description: * {"Player"} is the same as {Player = "Folder"}; Format like {SpawnLocation = "Part"} is only to be used when SpawnLocation inherits from "Part" AND "Part" is Creatable.

options.name: AlternativeWritefile
options.description: * Splits file content string into segments and writes them using appendfile. This might help with crashes when it starts writing to file. Though there is a risk of appendfile working incorrectly on some execs.

options.name: IgnoreDefaultPlayerScripts
options.description: * **RISKY**: Ignores Default PlayerScripts like PlayerModule & RbxCharacterSounds. Prevents crashes on some execs.

options.name: SharedBinaryStrings
options.description: Stores BinaryString values in a shared pool so identical ones are only written once, instead of repeating them for every instance. Good when many instances hold the same data (like copies of the same mesh) -- can make files noticeably smaller. Slightly bigger when everything is unique. Roblox doesn't officially support this, so there's a small chance it confuses Studio.

options.name: TreatUnionsAsParts
options.description: * **RISKY:** Converts all UnionOperations to Parts. Useful if your Executor isn't able to save (read) Unions, because otherwise they will be invisible.

presets.summary: Initial serializer and writer diagnosis, without script extraction.
Map-focused full-root export without decompilation or bytecode capture.
Authorized script-focused export with per-job decompilation and bytecode timeouts.
Experimental development target: preserve the widest accessible place content.
Ultra without ModuleScript code: keep module containers as Folders and preserve descendant models.
